text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low total protein, with mild hyperkalemia and elevated basophils. Neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages are low. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic disease, or acute infection. Clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
